description.en: A conservative living Elrathia reconstruction with an oval dorsal shield, closely repeated thoracic ribs and a small tail shield. Ventral limbs are comparative restorations, not soft tissues preserved in the anchor fossil; colour and fine details are uncertain.
description.zh: 保守的Elrathia活体复原，具有椭圆背甲、紧密胸部肋节与小尾盾。腹肢为比较复原，并非主锚化石保存的软组织；颜色和细部仍不确定。

anatomy: Plain oval outline with semicircular broad head, modest central glabella, small lateral compound eyes and short genalpoints. No elaborate knobs, hugeeyes orlongcephalicspines.

Thirteen closely spaced free thoracic tergites, narrowraised centralaxis and broader flattenedpleuralribs; simple short swept-back tips, no tall axialspines. Adult13segmentcondition supportedbyBright1959 andHopkins2021; notallontogeneticstagesidentical.
Small rounded pygidium, narrowfaintraisedaxialarea andsmoothoutermargin; no longtailspike orradiatingtailspines. Fusedpygidialrings must not be counted as additionalfree thoracictergites.
Paired slender antennules underfronthead and three smallpostantennularcephalic limb pairs conservatively restored frompolymeridtrilobitebodyplan.
One paired biramous limb unit under eachof13thoracicsegments, endopodwalkingramus and restrainedouterfilamentbranch. Keepunderpleurae, notgills onback orhugeexposed shrimp paddles.
Four progressively smaller pygidial limb pairs are anexplicit visualizationchoice, notameasuredspeciescount. Keepmostlyundershield andsimplified; precise hiddenmicroanatomynotclaimed.

scientific_limits.en: PRI76837 contains two fossils. The museum gives approximately40mm for the larger and30mm for the smaller; only the larger anchors this model. Viewed image is a museum fossil-scan preview, not a photograph of living anatomy. Ventral appendages are not visible and are explicitly group-informed restoration, not preserved PRI soft parts. Exact pygidial limb count, thickness, posture, fine setae and color are uncertain.
scientific_limits.zh: PRI76837包含两件化石；馆方大件约40毫米、小件约30毫米，本模型仅用大件作尺度锚。已看图为馆藏实物扫描预览，非活体照片。腹肢不可见，明确属于三叶虫类群层级的保守补配，不是PRI实存软组织；尾盾腹肢精确数、体厚、姿态、细毛与颜色不确定。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete conservative living Elrathia centered on the larger individual of museum specimen group PRI76837: plain oval dorsal test, closely repeated thoracic ribs and small rounded pygidium; restrained inferred ventral limbs, not fossil slab.
